---
title: "Fertilizer label calculator"
description: "Decode the N-P-K numbers on a fertilizer bag: how much product to spread for your lawn or garden, how many bags, and the real cost per pound of nitrogen."
anchor-sections: false
include-in-header: _hm-head.html
---

The three numbers on a fertilizer bag (N-P-K) are percentages by weight. A 20 lb bag of 24-0-6 contains 4.8 lb of nitrogen; the rest is the other nutrients and filler. This turns the label into how much product to spread, and shows what you're really paying per pound of nutrient.

```{=html}
<div class="hmc" id="fz"></div>
<script>
(function () {
  const NUT = { N: ['nitrogen (N)', 'n'], P: ['phosphate (P₂O₅)', 'p'], K: ['potash (K₂O)', 'k'] };
  HM.tool({
    id: 'fz', step: 'The bag',
    inputs: [
      { k: 'n', l: 'N', t: 'num', d: 24, w: 2 }, { k: 'p', l: 'P', t: 'num', d: 0, w: 2 }, { k: 'k', l: 'K', t: 'num', d: 6, w: 2 },
      { k: 'wt', l: 'Bag weight', t: 'mass', d: { us: 20, si: 10 }, w: 3 },
      { k: 'price', l: 'Price per bag', t: 'money', w: 3 },
      { t: 'sec', l: 'What you want to apply' },
      { k: 'area', l: 'Area', t: 'area' },
      { k: 'nut', l: 'Rate based on', t: 'seg', d: 'N', opts: [['N', 'Nitrogen'], ['P', 'Phosphate'], ['K', 'Potash']] },
      { k: 'rate', l: 'Rate per application', t: 'arate', d: { us: 1, si: 5 }, h: u => u === 'us' ? 'Lawns: usually ½–1 lb of nitrogen per 1,000 ft² per application. For phosphate and potash, use your soil test recommendation.' : 'Lawns: usually 2.5–5 g of nitrogen per m² per application. For phosphate and potash, use your soil test recommendation.' },
      { t: 'sec', l: 'Compare another product (optional)' },
      { k: 'n2', l: 'N', t: 'num', w: 2 }, { k: 'p2', l: 'P', t: 'num', w: 2 }, { k: 'k2', l: 'K', t: 'num', w: 2 },
      { k: 'wt2', l: 'Bag weight', t: 'mass', w: 3 }, { k: 'price2', l: 'Price per bag', t: 'money', w: 3 }
    ],
    compute(v, U) {
      const pct = { N: v.n || 0, P: v.p || 0, K: v.k || 0 }, sel = v.nut;
      if ((pct.N + pct.P + pct.K) > 100) return U.empty('The three numbers can\'t add up to more than 100.');
      if (!(v.wt > 0)) return U.empty('Enter the bag weight.');
      const bagNut = n => v.wt * pct[n] / 100; // kg of nutrient per bag
      const costPer = n => v.price > 0 && pct[n] > 0 ? v.price / (U.us ? bagNut(n) / 0.45359237 : bagNut(n)) : null;
      const work = [`One ${U.f(v.wt, 'mass', 1)} bag of ${HM.fmt(pct.N, 1)}-${HM.fmt(pct.P, 1)}-${HM.fmt(pct.K, 1)} contains ${['N', 'P', 'K'].map(n => `${U.f(bagNut(n), 'mass', 2)} ${n === 'N' ? 'N' : n === 'P' ? 'P₂O₅' : 'K₂O'}`).join(', ')}`];
      let h = '';
      if (pct[sel] <= 0) h = U.note(`This product has no ${NUT[sel][0]}, so it can't supply it. Choose another nutrient or product.`, 'bad');
      else if (v.rate > 0) {
        const prodRate = v.rate / (pct[sel] / 100); // g/m²
        work.push(`Product rate = ${U.f(v.rate, 'arate', 2)} ÷ ${HM.fmt(pct[sel], 1)}% = ${U.f(prodRate, 'arate', 2)} of product`);
        if (v.area > 0) {
          const kg = prodRate * v.area / 1000, bags = kg / v.wt;
          h = U.big('Spread', U.f(kg, 'mass', 1), `of this product over ${U.f(v.area, 'area', 0)}: that's ${HM.fmt(bags, 2)} bag${bags > 1.005 ? 's' : ''}. Set your spreader for ${U.f(prodRate, 'arate', 2)} using the chart on the bag.`);
          h += U.kv(['N', 'P', 'K'].map(n => [n === 'N' ? 'Nitrogen applied' : n === 'P' ? 'Phosphate (P₂O₅) applied' : 'Potash (K₂O) applied', `${U.f(prodRate * pct[n] / 100, 'arate', 2)}`]).concat(v.price > 0 ? [['Cost of this application', U.money(bags * v.price)]] : []));
          work.push(`Product for your area = ${U.f(prodRate, 'arate', 2)} × ${U.f(v.area, 'area', 0)} = ${U.f(kg, 'mass', 2)}`, `Bags = ${U.f(kg, 'mass', 2)} ÷ ${U.f(v.wt, 'mass', 1)} = ${HM.fmt(bags, 2)}`);
        } else {
          h = U.big('Spread', U.f(prodRate, 'arate', 2), 'of this product. Enter your area to see the total.');
        }
      }
      const cpn = costPer(sel), unitW = U.us ? 'lb' : 'kg';
      if (cpn != null) { h += U.kv([[`Cost per ${unitW} of ${NUT[sel][0]}`, U.money(cpn)]]); work.push(`Cost per ${unitW} of ${NUT[sel][0]} = ${U.money(v.price)} ÷ ${U.f(bagNut(sel), 'mass', 2)} = ${U.money(cpn)}`); }
      // second product
      const p2 = { N: v.n2 || 0, P: v.p2 || 0, K: v.k2 || 0 };
      if (v.wt2 > 0 && v.price2 > 0 && p2[sel] > 0 && cpn != null) {
        const c2 = v.price2 / (U.us ? v.wt2 * p2[sel] / 100 / 0.45359237 : v.wt2 * p2[sel] / 100);
        const better = c2 < cpn ? 'The second product' : 'This product';
        h += `<h3>Comparison</h3>` + U.kv([[`This product, per ${unitW} of ${sel}`, U.money(cpn)], [`Second product, per ${unitW} of ${sel}`, U.money(c2)]]) +
          U.note(`${better} is cheaper per ${unitW} of ${NUT[sel][0]} by ${HM.fmt(Math.abs(cpn - c2) / Math.max(cpn, c2) * 100, 0)}%. Price per bag tells you nothing until you divide by the nutrient in it.`, 'good');
        work.push(`Second product: ${U.money(v.price2)} ÷ (${U.f(v.wt2, 'mass', 1)} × ${HM.fmt(p2[sel], 1)}%) = ${U.money(c2)} per ${unitW}`);
      }
      if (pct.P > 0) h += U.note('Many lawns and gardens already have plenty of phosphorus, and some states and cities restrict phosphorus on lawns. Apply it only if a soil test shows it\'s low.');
      return { html: h || U.empty('Enter a rate.'), work };
    }
  });
})();
</script>
```

## Reading a fertilizer label

- **N (nitrogen)** drives green leafy growth. It's the nutrient lawns need most, and it doesn't stay in soil long, which is why it's applied regularly.
- **P (phosphate, P₂O₅)** supports roots and establishment. The label shows phosphate, not pure phosphorus: elemental P is about 44% of the P₂O₅ number.
- **K (potash, K₂O)** helps with stress tolerance. Elemental K is about 83% of the K₂O number.
- **Slow-release** or **organic** products feed over weeks rather than days. The arithmetic is the same; they're just gentler.

More is not better. Extra nitrogen means more mowing, weaker roots and nitrate washing into waterways. A [soil test](soil-test-translator.qmd) tells you whether you need phosphate or potash at all.
